mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 5.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below trend for two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS < trend for two quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals improving manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings expectations and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO > 12-month MA for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in nonfarm payrolls above trend for three consecutive months signals robust labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS > trend for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Housing Starts Index above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals improving residential demand, which boosts construction-related earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when HOUST > 12-month MA for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index above 2.5% for three consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, which prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
